mapper.select: select hpd.definition_id, hpd.definition_code, hpd.definition_name, hpd.description, hpd.price_list, hpd.repay_flag, hpd.service_fee_repay_flag, hpd.residual_price_type, hpd.int_rate_calc_flag, hpd.payment_bp_type, hpd.lease_charge_discount_rule, hpd.rental_discount_times, (SELECT B2.MEANING FROM SYS_CODE_B B1, SYS_CODE_VALUE_B B2 WHERE B1.CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' AND B1.CODE_ID = B2.CODE_ID AND B2.VALUE = hpd.int_rate_calc_flag) int_rate_calc_flag_n, (SELECT B2.MEANING FROM SYS_CODE_B B1, SYS_CODE_VALUE_B B2 WHERE B1.CODE = 'CHARGE_DISCOUNT_RULE' AND B1.CODE_ID = B2.CODE_ID AND B2.VALUE = hpd.lease_charge_discount_rule) lease_charge_discount_rule_n, (SELECT B2.MEANING FROM SYS_CODE_B B1, SYS_CODE_VALUE_B B2 WHERE B1.CODE = 'DISCOUNT_TIMES' AND B1.CODE_ID = B2.CODE_ID AND B2.VALUE = hpd.rental_discount_times) rental_discount_times_n, (select s.MEANING from sys_code_value_b_v s where s.CODE = 'HLS500_ANNUAL_PAY_TIMES' and s.code_value = to_char(hpd.annual_pay_times)) annual_pay_times_n, hpd.annual_pay_times, (select s.MEANING from sys_code_value_b_v s where s.CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' and s.code_value = hpd.repay_flag) repay_flag_n, (select s.MEANING from sys_code_value_b_v s where s.CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' and s.code_value = hpd.service_fee_repay_flag) service_fee_repay_flag_n, (select prl.description from hls_price_list prl where prl.price_list = hpd.price_list) price_list_n, (select hpdp.DEFAULT_VALUE from hls_product_definition_para hpdp where hpdp.definition_id = hpd.definition_id and hpdp.product_para = 'INT_RATE') int_rate, (select hpdp.DEFAULT_VALUE from hls_product_definition_para hpdp where hpdp.definition_id = hpd.definition_id and hpdp.product_para = 'LEASE_CHARGE_RATIO') lease_charge_ratio, (select hpdp.DEFAULT_VALUE from hls_product_definition_para hpdp where hpdp.definition_id = hpd.definition_id and hpdp.product_para = 'DOWN_PAYMENT_RATIO') down_payment_ratio, (select hpdp.DEFAULT_VALUE from hls_product_definition_para hpdp where hpdp.definition_id = hpd.definition_id and hpdp.product_para = 'DEPOSIT_RATIO') deposit_ratio, (select hpdp.DEFAULT_VALUE from hls_product_definition_para hpdp where hpdp.definition_id = hpd.definition_id and hpdp.product_para = 'LEASE_TERM') lease_term, (select hpdp.DEFAULT_VALUE from hls_product_definition_para hpdp where hpdp.definition_id = hpd.definition_id and hpdp.product_para = 'RESIDUAL_VALUE') default_residual_value from hls_product_definition hpd where hpd.enabled_flag = 'Y' and hpd.definition_id = #{definitionId}
select hpd.* from hls_product_definition hpd, hls_reply_product hrp where hpd.reply_product_id = hrp.reply_product_id and hrp.reply_id = #{replyId}

select hpd.definition_id, hcl_child.credit_line_id, hpd.annual_pay_times, hpd.price_list, hpd.residual_price_type, hpd.step_quotation_flag, hpd.residual_value_received, hpd.repay_mode, hpd.payment_bp_type, hpd.repay_bp_type, hpd.int_rate_calc_flag, hpd.lease_charge_discount_rule, hpd.rental_discount_times, (select hbrp.default_value from hls_bp_reply_para hbrp where hbrp.reply_id = hbm.reply_id and hbrp.reply_para = 'INSURANCE_FREE_AMOUNT') insurance_free_amount, (select hbrp.default_value from hls_bp_reply_para hbrp where hbrp.reply_id = hbm.reply_id and hbrp.reply_para = 'INSURANCE_FREE_PERIOD') insurance_free_period, hpd.pay_type, (select hpdp.default_value from hls_product_definition_para hpdp where hpdp.definition_id = hpd.definition_id and hpdp.product_para = 'GRACE_PERIOD' and hpdp.enabled_flag = 'Y') gracePeriod, (select hpdp.default_value from hls_product_definition_para hpdp where hpdp.definition_id = hpd.definition_id and hpdp.product_para = 'PENALTY_RATE' and hpdp.enabled_flag = 'Y') penaltyRate, (select hpdp.default_value from hls_product_definition_para hpdp where hpdp.definition_id = hpd.definition_id and hpdp.product_para = 'MANUFACTURER_GRACE_DAY' and hpdp.enabled_flag = 'Y') manufacturerGraceDay, (select hpdp.default_value from hls_product_definition_para hpdp where hpdp.definition_id = hpd.definition_id and hpdp.product_para = 'MANUFACTURER_PENALTY_RATE' and hpdp.enabled_flag = 'Y') manufacturerPenaltyRate, (select hpdp.default_value from hls_product_definition_para hpdp where hpdp.definition_id = hpd.definition_id and hpdp.product_para = 'RESIDUAL_VALUE' and hpdp.enabled_flag = 'Y') residualValue, (SELECT B2.MEANING FROM SYS_CODE_B B1, SYS_CODE_VALUE_B B2 WHERE B1.CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' AND B1.CODE_ID = B2.CODE_ID AND B2.VALUE = hpd.int_rate_calc_flag) int_rate_calc_flag_n, (SELECT B2.MEANING FROM SYS_CODE_B B1, SYS_CODE_VALUE_B B2 WHERE B1.CODE = 'CHARGE_DISCOUNT_RULE' AND B1.CODE_ID = B2.CODE_ID AND B2.VALUE = hpd.lease_charge_discount_rule) lease_charge_discount_rule_n, (SELECT B2.MEANING FROM SYS_CODE_B B1, SYS_CODE_VALUE_B B2 WHERE B1.CODE = 'DISCOUNT_TIMES' AND B1.CODE_ID = B2.CODE_ID AND B2.VALUE = hpd.rental_discount_times) rental_discount_times_n from hls_product_definition hpd, hls_reply_product hrp, hls_bp_master_reply hbm, hls_credit_line hcl, hls_credit_line hcl_child where hpd.reply_product_id = hrp.reply_product_id and hrp.reply_id = hbm.reply_id and hbm.credit_line_id = hcl.credit_line_id and hcl_child.p_credit_line_id = hcl.credit_line_id and hcl_child.credit_type = hrp.credit_type and hcl.bp_id = #{bpId} and hpd.definition_code = #{definitionCode} and hpd.enabled_flag = 'Y'

SELECT hpd.definition_code FROM hls_product_definition hpd, hls_reply_product hrp, hls_bp_master_reply hbmr, hls_credit_line hcl where hrp.reply_id = hbmr.reply_id and hbmr.credit_line_id = hcl.credit_line_id and hpd.reply_product_id = hrp.reply_product_id and hcl.bp_id = #{bpId} and hpd.price_list = #{priceList}
SELECT hpd.* FROM hls_product_definition hpd where hpd.definition_code = #{definitionCode} and hpd.enabled_flag = 'Y'

SELECT hpd.* FROM hls_product_def_dealer hpdd,hls_product_definition hpd
hpd.definition_id = hpdd.definition_id AND hpdd.dealer_id = #{dealerId}
